description: Stage 2 streaming matrix subset: first five real-model tasks.

tasks.prompt: Fix miniapp/calculator.py so safe_divide returns the quotient for normal inputs and raises ValueError with message 'division by zero' when the denominator is zero. Run the targeted test before finishing.
tasks.expected_artifact: miniapp/calculator.py implements the safe division contract

tasks.prompt: Fix parse_csv_line in miniapp/parser.py. It must trim whitespace around fields, discard empty fields, and return an empty list for a blank line. Run the targeted test before finishing.

Fix run_with_retries in miniapp/retry.py. max_attempts is the total number of calls, not the number of retries after the first call. Reject max_attempts below 1 with ValueError, return immediately on success, and re-raise the final exception after the budget is exhausted. Run the targeted test.
tasks.expected_artifact: miniapp/retry.py obeys the total attempt budget

tasks.prompt: Fix BucketCache in miniapp/cache.py so separate instances never share their default storage, while callers may still pass an explicit dictionary to use as storage. Run the targeted test before finishing.
tasks.expected_artifact: miniapp/cache.py avoids shared mutable default state

tasks.prompt: The default request timeout must be 45 seconds everywhere. Make miniapp/config.py the single source of truth and update miniapp/runtime.py to use that constant instead of duplicating a literal. Preserve explicit timeout overrides and run the targeted test.
tasks.expected_artifact: config and runtime share one default timeout constant
